_comment: Text models for the built-in engine (AI-7, provider `embedded`): GGUF files run by the bundled llama-server. Same rules as models.json: an entry with pending_pin true has no pinned checksum yet, so it is hidden from the AI page and every action on it is refused until the maintainer fills in url (pinned to a commit), file, sha256, bytes, ram_mb, license and context_tokens and removes the flag. The three entries (Gemma 4 E2B, Qwen3.5 4B, Qwen3.5 2B; maintainer decision Oct 27, 2026) are pinned from docs/research/text-model-pins-2026-10-27.md (checksums and sizes read from the Hugging Face LFS pointer files at the commits in the urls on Oct 27, 2026; no file downloaded yet; ram_mb is an estimate: file plus a 16K context cache plus buffers, not measured on a Mac). recommended marks the one default entry (exactly one is allowed to be true); ram_mb is the memory the model needs while it runs, in MB; context_tokens is the context the engine starts it with; license must be Apache-2.0 or MIT. To use another mirror or revision, put a file of this shape at <config dir>/ai/text/catalog.json or point CAPTUREMANN_TEXT_CATALOG at one: it replaces this list.

models.label: Gemma 4 E2B
models.hint: Recommended for reports and notes on every Mac. Best score in our test, English and Vietnamese.

models.label: Gemma 4 26B-A4B
models.hint: Higher quality for Macs with plenty of memory: better at decisions, owners and translation. About 15 GB to download.

models.label: Qwen3.5 4B
models.hint: Optional: best for translation into other languages. Needs about 4 GB of memory.

models.label: Qwen3.5 2B
models.hint: Smallest option for Macs with little free memory. Notes can miss items.
